title: Fix some spelling mistakes
description:
Also teach check_spelling.py to remove common mispellings
from dictionary by fetching/parsing page.  Reuses
some code from Darius's script.

@@ -14,6 +14,9 @@ import signal import glob from collections import Counter +from html.parser import HTMLParser +import urllib.request + # Looks for spelling errors among strings found in source or documentation files. # N.B., # - To run this script, you should install pyspellchecker (not spellchecker) using pip. @@ -53,8 +56,59 @@ from spellchecker import SpellChecker spell = SpellChecker() spell.word_frequency.load_text_file('./tools/wireshark_words.txt') -# TODO: this should include the full list from Wikipedia page as used by Darius's script -spell.word_frequency.remove_words([ 'futher', 'extention']) + +class TypoSourceDocumentParser(HTMLParser): + def __init__(self): + super().__init__() + self.capturing = False + self.content = '' + + def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs): + if tag == 'pre': + self.capturing = True + + def handle_endtag(self, tag): + if tag == 'pre': + self.capturing = False + + def handle_data(self, data): + if self.capturing: + self.content += data + + +# Fetch some common mispellings from wikipedia so we will definitely flag them. +print('Fetching Wikipedia\'s list of common misspellings.') +req_headers = { 'User-Agent': 'Wireshark check-wikipedia-typos' } +req = urllib.request.Request('https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Lists_of_common_misspellings/For_machines', headers=req_headers) +try: + response = urllib.request.urlopen(req) + content = response.read() + content = content.decode('UTF-8', 'replace') + + # Extract the "
...
" part of the document. + parser = TypoSourceDocumentParser() + parser.feed(content) + content = parser.content.strip() + + db = dict(l.lower().split('->', maxsplit=1) for l in content.splitlines()) + del db['cmo'] # All false positives. + del db['ect'] # Too many false positives. + del db['thru'] # We'll let that one thru. ;-) + del db['sargeant'] # All false positives. + + # Remove each word from dict + removed = 0 + for word in db: + try: + spell.word_frequency.remove_words([word]) + #print('Removed', word) + removed += 1 + except: + pass + + print('Removed', removed, 'known bad words') +except: + print('Failed to fetch and/or parse Wikipedia mispellings!') # Track words that were not found. @@ -236,8 +290,6 @@ class File: if self.numberPlusUnits(word): continue - if word == "extension": - print('checking', word) if len(word) > 4 and spell.unknown([word]) and not self.checkMultiWords(word) and not self.wordBeforeId(word): print(self.file, value_index, '/', num_values, '"' + original + '"', bcolors.FAIL + word + bcolors.ENDC, ' -> ', '?')
